question: How does one stand in supreme bliss and become freed?
premises: One is adorned by the apana moon.
Then one is freed by single contact of endless shining objects.
inference: Standing in supreme bliss adorned by the apana moon, one becomes freed by single contact of endless shining objects.
uncertainties: Both supplied tokens are long compounds and may contain multiple sandhi boundaries.
plain_english: Standing in supreme bliss, adorned by the apana moon, then one is freed by the single contact of endless shining objects.
